children: Motilal Oswal's research report on Symbiotec Pharmalab

Symbiotec Pharmalab (SYMBIOTEC) has evolved from a steroidal API manufacturer into an integrated platform spanning active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), fermentation-led CDMO, and complex injectables, backed by manufacturing investments and backward integration. A leading corticosteroid/hormone API supplier (total addressable market (TAM): USD800m), SYMBIOTEC is expanding into fermentation-based and high-value complex APIs (TAM: USD92b; 10.4% CAGR over CY24–29). SYMBIOTEC is already on a path to provide chemistry- and fermentation-based capabilities and capacity as a CDMO platform in precision fermentation, industrial biotechnology, and biologics, targeting a TAM of USD50b. It has invested in building a manufacturing facility to forward integrate into double chamber vials (DCVs; TAM of USD3b), which not only enables better profitability but also enhances traction in the most heavily regulated market (the US).

We value SYMBIOTEC at 35x 12M forward earnings (in-line to the sector P/E of ~36x) to arrive at our TP of INR1,430, factoring in the company’s established API base and earnings potential from the newer businesses.
